Ghana

Vaccine Recommendations

Yellow fever

Yellow fever is a viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes which predominantly feed between dawn and dusk, but may also bite at night, especially in the jungle environment.

There is a risk of yellow fever transmission throughout this country.

Dengue

There is a risk of dengue in this country. Travellers should avoid mosquito bites, particularly during daytime hours.

Malaria

The disease is transmitted by mosquitoes which predominantly feed between dusk and dawn.

There is a high risk of malaria in Ghana: atovaquone/proguanil OR doxycycline OR mefloquine recommended

Outbreaks

As of 8 October 2026, Ghana's Ministry of Health has reported three confirmed fatal yellow fever cases in Upper West Region. An emergency response, including deployment of rapid response teams and a targeted vaccination campaign, is ongoing.
